channel.title: Floppy Key devblog
channel.description: What changed in every update of Floppy Key's games, and why.

item.title: THE SEAL QUEST : Disk 02: The Seal Quest
item.category: The Seal Quest: Dreams of Ormaz
item.description: The second Floppy Key game: an incremental defense RPG where you hunt epic beasts for their loot. Every epic you hunt wakes something bigger.

item.title: STRIKE! v1.2.2: Milestones, the Strike Fund and critical hits
item.description: New things to chase between floors: milestones, the Strike Fund and a destruction level. Bigger critical hits, floors that shatter when you wreck them, and floor 7 is no longer a wall.

item.title: STRIKE! v1.2.0: Headquarters: Act 2 is here
item.description: A whole second act: ten new floors at headquarters, glass partitions and armored servers, surprise boxes, twelve new upgrades and an org chart you can drag and zoom.
